description:
Hello! We’re from Córdoba, Argentina.

We’re developing a game for the NASA Space Apps Challenge where you design your own spacecraft, conduct experiments in laboratories, and play as part of a four-person team. You’ll make decisions during space missions across the galaxy—all while having fun, managing limited resources, facing unexpected challenges, and carrying out rescue operations.

If you enjoy adventure and exploration games, come join the adventure! We’d love to have you on board!
